verdict.rationale: Performance and item caps at large scale are a fair question for a project-tracking tool, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of performance with tens of thousands of stories and does not say whether workspace item caps exist. 'Quick load times' is generic marketing with no scale context, and per-workflow-state story limits are a user-set WIP control, not a product item cap.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
